components.name: Pointed throne wall and dais host
components.function: Missing construction views behind existing room snapshots; generic substrate plus source-compatible interior faces
components.construction: One isolated pointed throne wall and dais host, original palace rose and ivory marble, gold trim, blue/rose glass where source appropriate. Show interior face, ceiling/underside and rear wall/roof contact. Real door/window apertures open; furniture/foliage removable. Preserve local room character rather than replacing with one generic hall.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
components.notes: Source backs, dimensions, repeat patterns, inter-view parity and physical attachment remain unverified. Whole-sheet generation does not prove individual meshes are separable.
